authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Development plan document type dataset contains 16 MHCLG-created document-type identifiers, including local-plan, policies-map, local-development-scheme, local-plan-review and site-allocations; all 16 records were considered, within the 50-record bound. This register can classify future-growth planning evidence after an authoritative slot geography/organisation/development-plan binding exists, but it contains no slot-specific geography and does not identify which authority or development plan belongs to future_growth_3. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative development-plan reference, local-plan-boundary reference, LPA/LAD identifier/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting a plan, authority, or polygon would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
